novel_facts: Davis was released from Lee County Jail on Sunday after posting a $100,000 bond.
The sheriff's office announced increased deputy presence at Felix A. Williams Elementary School and several other Martin County schools following his release.
Principal Sarah Tuthill issued a Sunday-night statement confirming additional campus security and that school would remain open.
